name: wrangler-squared
description: Automated jobs for Agent Wrangler, as an installable extension

wranglerExtension.label: Automated jobs (Wrangler²)
wranglerExtension.description: Plan a goal into PRs (under Jira stories where the work has tickets), run each step as its own bounded agent session in a dedicated worktree, and gate the risky moments (plan, code, merge) on a human.
wranglerExtension.author: Charlie Goldstraw
